auctionData.allsop_addendumnotes:
The following general addendum applies to each and every Lot in the auction:
The auction is subject to and in accordance with the Auctioneer Terms as published on the Allsop LLP auction website.
Some Special Conditions of Sale detail extra costs payable in addition to the purchase price and the Buyers’ Fee. Please check the Special Conditions of Sale carefully for any such costs. 
The Particulars may change at any time prior to the Auction. Where there are changes, we will use reasonable endeavours to highlight them in the Addendum. It is your responsibility to check you have seen the correct version of the Particulars on the website and have read the Addendum for the Lot, prior to bidding.
Reference in special conditions of sale to documents being annexed or attached to those special conditions shall be construed as meaning either, that such documents are in fact annexed or attached, or that they are available in the legal pack for the Lot.
Where a video tour has been provided in the online Particulars of Sale, this is intended to assist buyers by giving a general impression of the layout of the property. It is not intended to specifically include or omit any particular part of the property and is not to be relied upon as a formal record of condition of the property. For the avoidance of doubt, neither the Seller nor the Auctioneers will have any liability in the event that there is a defect existing at the property, which would be visible on a physical inspection, but is not shown on the video tour. 
Unless you obtain prior consent (for which a charge might be made) changes to the Buyer named in your application to bid in the auction cannot be made. The Lot can only be transferred to the Buyer named in your application and purchase agreement.
Amendments to the Particulars of Sale and Conditions of Sale detailed in both the General and any Lot-specific addenda shall be deemed to be part of the said Particulars and Conditions of Sale and if in conflict shall prevail.
